title: Minigame: C10.3 Pushing a Gun

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as a minigame of the Rules-first plan (the C10.3 claim): a German crew pushes its leIG across open ground, a hedge, and a road in front of a Russian squad, and a truck hooks it up, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the units are set up by hand, a German crew manning a 7.5cm leIG 18 (M# 10, QSU) in Open Ground [Q3] beside the road, a truck in its hex, and a Russian squad in view.

introduction: A crew pushes its Gun across open ground, a hedge, and a road, in fair weather and foul: what is the Manhandling DRM, and when may the Gun be pushed on or hooked up?

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
